activities.whatToDo: Immigration, baggage claim, buy local Beeline/Tele2 SIM, order Yandex XL Taxi to hotel.
activities.mustTry: Local SIM card setup at arrivals
activities.lookOutFor: Allow 1-1.5 hrs; ignore aggressive unlicensed airport taxi drivers, use Yandex Go

activities.whatToDo: Check-in & drop off luggage in room/storage.
activities.mustTry: Request early check-in if available
activities.lookOutFor: Keep passports handy for registration

activities.whatToDo: Authentic local kickoff lunch: traditional Lagman, Beshbarmak, or Shashlik.
activities.mustTry: Boshu Lagman (hand-pulled noodles) & Manti
activities.lookOutFor: Generous portions; use Yandex Go for reliable taxi rides

activities.whatToDo: Explore indoor market stalls, local spices, honey, dried fruits and cheeses.
activities.mustTry: Kurt (salted cheese balls), mountain honey, Kazy (horse meat)
activities.lookOutFor: Closes around 18:00 (closed on Mondays); cash preferred for stalls

activities.whatToDo: Walk park & explore Zenkov Cathedral built entirely of wood without metal nails.
activities.mustTry: Admire the wooden architecture & golden domes
activities.lookOutFor: Modest dress required inside cathedral (women cover heads, men remove hats)

activities.whatToDo: Stroll pedestrian street, browse street art, buskers, and open-air cafes.
activities.mustTry: Street art & artisan souvenir stalls
activities.lookOutFor: Great evening atmosphere; temperatures drop quickly after sunset

activities.whatToDo: Dinner & drinks: local craft beer or Georgian cuisine (Khachapuri & Shashlik).
activities.mustTry: Georgian feast or craft brew at Harat's
activities.lookOutFor: Many popular city spots require weekend reservations

title: Medeu, Shymbulak, Car Rental & Kok Tobe

activities.whatToDo: Local breakfast & specialty coffee; fuel up for high altitude.
activities.mustTry: Syrniki (cottage cheese pancakes) with berry jam
activities.lookOutFor: Top up Onay bus card or keep contactless bank card ready

activities.whatToDo: High-altitude speed skating rink area. Take Bus No. 12 from Hotel Kazakhstan.
activities.mustTry: World's highest outdoor ice rink panorama
activities.lookOutFor: Dress warmly; significantly colder than city level

activities.whatToDo: Cable car ride up to Talgar Pass (3,200m) for panoramic snow mountain views.
activities.mustTry: Snow-capped Tien Shan peaks & glacier air
activities.lookOutFor: Cable cars run until Oct 18. Expect snow & freezing winds at top

activities.whatToDo: Lunch with a mountain view at 3,200m chalet dining.
activities.mustTry: Hot mountain herbal tea & grilled meats
activities.lookOutFor: Food is pricier at the resort; stay warm

activities.whatToDo: Return to city and pick up 6-day rental minivan/crossover (Vladex or similar).
activities.mustTry: Thorough vehicle inspection, jack & spare tire check
activities.lookOutFor: CRITICAL: Visually inspect tires — MUST be winter tires (studded/friction) for Oct mountains

activities.whatToDo: Aerial cable car from Dostyk Ave to Kok Tobe for sunset golden hour over Almaty.
activities.mustTry: Almaty TV Tower view & sunset over Tien Shan range
activities.lookOutFor: Cable car tickets ~2,500 KZT roundtrip; dress in layers

activities.whatToDo: Shop road trip groceries: 5L drinking water jugs, dry snacks, nuts, toilet paper.
activities.mustTry: Kazakh chocolate, dried fruit bars, wet wipes
activities.lookOutFor: Stock up thoroughly; remote village shops have limited supplies

activities.whatToDo: Hearty city dinner and rest up before early morning road trip start.
activities.mustTry: Navat or Parmigiano dinner
activities.lookOutFor: Ensure phones/powerbanks are 100% charged overnight

title: Issyk Lake, Turgen Gorge & Chundzha Hot Springs

activities.whatToDo: Breakfast, hotel check-out & vehicle winter check. Check spare tire, fuel up to 100%.
activities.mustTry: Test car heating system & wiper fluid before leaving city
activities.lookOutFor: Fuel up at Compass or Qazaq Oil station

activities.whatToDo: Drive ~80 km east towards Issyk Lake along the scenic mountain highway.
activities.mustTry: Scenic morning foothills of Zailiyskiy Alatau
activities.lookOutFor: Obey speed limits strictly (50-60 km/h in villages); traffic police radar is active

activities.whatToDo: Explore alpine lake, photography, and walk along the turquoise waters.
activities.mustTry: Turquoise lake reflection against golden autumn slopes
activities.lookOutFor: Extremely strong cold winds off the water; wear thermals, windbreaker & gloves

activities.whatToDo: Drive into Turgen river gorge, enjoy lunch and hike to Bear Waterfall (Medvezhiy).
activities.mustTry: Hike to 30m waterfall & fresh mountain trout lunch
activities.lookOutFor: Trail may be muddy, slippery, or icy in October; wear sturdy boots

activities.whatToDo: Drive east along Kulja tract to Chundzha thermal springs area. Check-in to resort.
activities.mustTry: Arrive before dark; heated indoor/outdoor mineral pools
activities.lookOutFor: Temps drop fast; safe thermal resort stay replaces dangerous cold camping

activities.whatToDo: Night soak in naturally heated thermal mineral pools (38°C–44°C) under starlit sky & dinner.
activities.mustTry: Mineral water thermal soak in crisp October evening air
activities.lookOutFor: Bring swimwear & slippers; great recovery for muscles

activities.whatToDo: Breakfast & checkout. Hot tea and local breads.
activities.mustTry: Fresh village cream, bread and honey
activities.lookOutFor: Ensure car windows are fully defrosted before driving

activities.whatToDo: Drive south-west towards Charyn Canyon across wide autumn steppe landscape.
activities.mustTry: Changing semi-desert steppe scenery
activities.lookOutFor: Watch out for morning black ice in shaded valley dips

activities.whatToDo: Hike 2.5 km down dramatic red sandstone canyon to the rushing Charyn River & picnic.
activities.mustTry: Spectacular red rock towers; eco-bus ride back if tired
activities.lookOutFor: October climate is ideal (cool & crisp); carry at least 1.5L water per person

activities.whatToDo: Photo stop along main highway to view the deep, dark volcanic river gorge.
activities.mustTry: Sheer 100m vertical canyon drop and rushing river view
activities.lookOutFor: 15-20 min stop right by main road to Saty; strong winds at edge

activities.whatToDo: Arrive in Saty village, check into welcoming family guesthouse, enjoy homemade Kazakh dinner.
activities.mustTry: Baursak, homemade Kuurdak/Beshbarmak, fresh herbal mountain tea
activities.lookOutFor: Cash-only payments in village; ask host for extra thick blankets for freezing night

activities.whatToDo: Hearty guesthouse breakfast with farm eggs, local jams, and hot tea.
activities.mustTry: Hot homemade breakfast before cold mountain trek
activities.lookOutFor: Eat well; you need energy for the crisp outdoor cold

activities.whatToDo: Hire local Soviet UAZ Bukhanka 4x4 van from Saty. Hike/horseback to submerged birch tree trunks.
activities.mustTry: Eerie spruce tree trunks preserved in turquoise mountain lake
activities.lookOutFor: Do NOT drive rental car here (rough riverbed breaks cars). Trail can be snowy/slippery

activities.whatToDo: Return to guesthouse for hot soup (Shurpa or Borscht) and tea.
activities.mustTry: Hot mountain broth to warm up after Kaindy
activities.lookOutFor: Rest up before afternoon lake trip

activities.whatToDo: Drive 20 mins on smooth asphalt road to Lower Kolsai. Lakeshore walk and rowboat.
activities.mustTry: Wooden rowboat cruise or stroll along alpine shoreline
activities.lookOutFor: Paved road from Saty; stunning autumn golden larch trees or early snow dust

activities.whatToDo: Homemade dinner by host and unpolluted mountain stargazing.
activities.mustTry: Milky way views in pitch-black mountain village sky
activities.lookOutFor: Temperatures drop well below freezing (-5°C to -10°C); bundle up!

activities.whatToDo: Early breakfast & checkout. Fill thermoses with hot tea.
activities.mustTry: Hot tea for the road
activities.lookOutFor: Scrape morning ice off windshield before departure

activities.whatToDo: 4.5 to 5-hour drive to Basshi village via Chilik corridor and Kokpek pass.
activities.mustTry: Dramatic transition from snow alpine peaks to golden desert steppe
activities.lookOutFor: Keep tank topped up; long stretches without services

activities.whatToDo: Register vehicle and pay entrance permits at Altyn Emel National Park headquarters; check-in.
activities.mustTry: Local village lunch and national park registration
activities.lookOutFor: Mandatory: Keep park permit receipt displayed on car dashboard

activities.whatToDo: Drive 45 km gravel track to Singing Dunes. Climb dune ridge and slide down to hear acoustic vibration.
activities.mustTry: Loud organ-like humming produced by vibrating dry sand
activities.lookOutFor: Cap speed at 40 km/h on washboard gravel; deflate tires slightly for comfort

activities.whatToDo: Return to guesthouse for dinner and rest after the dune climb.
activities.mustTry: Homestyle Kazakh hospitality in remote steppe village
activities.lookOutFor: Staying in Basshi eliminates a brutal 12-hour nighttime driving marathon to Almaty

activities.whatToDo: Early breakfast and checkout to maximize daylight.
activities.mustTry: Warm breakfast & coffee
activities.lookOutFor: Ensure full water supply and check tire pressures for desert trip

activities.whatToDo: Drive inside park to the alien-like white, red, and banded chalk mountains.
activities.mustTry: Hike through Martian layered sedimentary canyons
activities.lookOutFor: 90 km washboard track takes 1.5-2 hrs each way; extremely bumpy gravel

activities.whatToDo: Drive back through Basshi village towards the main highway.
activities.mustTry: Steppe views & wild Kulan (wild ass) or Goitered Gazelle sightings
activities.lookOutFor: Re-inflate tires at roadside compressor if you deflated them

activities.whatToDo: 4-hour highway drive back to Almaty via Kapchagay (Qonaev) lake stop for lunch.
activities.mustTry: Fresh lake fish lunch near Kapchagay reservoir
activities.lookOutFor: Smooth multi-lane A3 tollway into Almaty

activities.whatToDo: Return rental car (clean interior, full fuel tank) and check in to Almaty hotel.
activities.mustTry: Retrieve stored luggage from hotel storage
activities.lookOutFor: Thorough vehicle check for road trip scratches/dust

activities.whatToDo: Historic Soviet/Kazakh public bathhouse recovery session & sauna massage.
activities.mustTry: Venik (oak leaf bundle) sauna steam massage & cold plunge
activities.lookOutFor: Gender-segregated; incredible way to soothe muscles after road trip

activities.whatToDo: Celebratory road trip completion dinner with craft drinks & local music.
activities.mustTry: Traditional Kazakh feast at Navat, Kishlak or Gosti
activities.lookOutFor: Celebrate successful 6-day road expedition!

activities.whatToDo: Scenic morning excursion to Big Almaty Lake via authorized eco-shuttle.
activities.mustTry: Turquoise alpine reservoir surrounded by snowy Tien Shan peaks
activities.lookOutFor: Private cars banned. Must carry original passports for border control zone

activities.whatToDo: Lunch along Dostyk Avenue / Panfilov Street; relaxed cafe culture.
activities.mustTry: Central Asian baked pastries, tea and craft coffee
activities.lookOutFor: Relaxed urban vibe before flight packing

activities.whatToDo: Souvenir and chocolate shopping at official factory store on Zenkov Street.
activities.mustTry: Signature blue-wrapped 'Kazakhstan' chocolate bars & tins
activities.lookOutFor: Factory store offers freshest stock and best wholesale prices

activities.whatToDo: Pick up stored luggage, repack all souvenirs, and call Yandex XL Taxi to ALA airport.
activities.mustTry: Check baggage weight and pack chocolates in carry-on
activities.lookOutFor: Allow 45-60 mins for airport transit; Sunday evening traffic can peak

activities.whatToDo: Airport check-in 3 hours prior to international departure, security and duty-free.
activities.mustTry: Final airport duty-free & boarding
activities.lookOutFor: Safe flight home to India with incredible memories of Kazakhstan!
